About this site

This site helps refresh computer science knowledge. Each guide explains one topic, and each level in the game practises it.

How the pages are written

Each guide is written in plain words and starts from an everyday example. Facts come from the sources listed at the end of each page. Extra detail for readers who want more sits in a section called Go deeper.

AI use

AI helped build this site and write the first drafts. Not every page has been fully checked yet. If something looks wrong, please report it.

Report a mistake

The project's README on GitHub explains how to report a mistake: how to report a mistake.
